verdict.rationale: Calendly is a scheduling SaaS whose MCP role is that of a server: it publishes the Calendly MCP server that external AI apps connect to. That is the opposite direction of this story and cannot be credited here. Nothing in the evidence shows Calendly or its assistants (Callie, the meeting AI assistant) acting as an MCP client that loads third-party MCP servers, so this client-side axis does not fit the product's role.
